replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. You start by standardizing the data, then compute the covariance matrix. Next, you find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of this matrix. The eigenvectors with the highest eigenvalues are the principal components. You can then project the data onto these components. The math can be complex, but there are many tools and software that can help you perform PCA without getting too deep into the mathematics.
